lines.text: It's our anniversary. Auntie Sol at Moon Noodles has my gift, a limited-edition heat sink. I paid already. Could you pick it up? She deserves better thermal management.
lines.direction: Earnest, conversational; sincere thanks, never a punchline delivery.

lines.text: Look at that copper finish. She's going to be so happy. Or at least her temperature sensors will be. Here's eighty-five bucks. Thanks, choom.
lines.direction: Earnest, conversational; sincere thanks, never a punchline delivery.

lines.text: People around here say you keep your word. Take this demo to Rae at Blue Hour. No algorithms, no auditions by committee. Just let someone hear it.
lines.direction: Casual direct address to a trusted local; understated, sincere.

lines.text: Nyx sent you? Good. This city needs more people making music, not more people selling subscriptions to it. I'll keep your name on the list.
lines.direction: Casual direct address to a trusted local; understated, sincere.

lines.text: Yo, three dead toes but I still walk the beat. Corporate suits got nothin' on me. I'll beat ya brain, put the bass in your street. Daddy Stanky, underground, never sold a seat.
lines.direction: Loose conversational swagger, spontaneous rhyme and comic timing.

lines.text: Everybody thinks they know me, bro. Calm down, little predatah. I got jokes, I got bars, but I got a heart too. I'll show you my humanity.
lines.direction: Quiet, vulnerable and sincere; allow a beat of silence.

lines.text: SHAWKTOOTH! Three dead toes, nobody knows. No cashy, still flashy. Smokey the cokey, hokey pokey. Man, I rhyme when I order a sandwich. That's a condition, bro.
lines.direction: Loose conversational swagger, spontaneous rhyme and comic timing.

source.question: Why do they call you Sharktooth?

lines.text: Mother Mary, shit got scary. I was in a car I had no business bein' in. Swear I heard that pendant tell me to stay put. Then BANG, somebody sideswiped the whole thing. Coulda been luck, coulda been my head. I still wear her.
lines.direction: Loose conversational swagger, spontaneous rhyme and comic timing.

lines.text: Me and my neighbor had a disagreement. The shovel had a different opinion. Big talky, little walky. I ain't proud of every damn thing I done, bro.
lines.direction: Loose conversational swagger, spontaneous rhyme and comic timing.

lines.text: Calm down, little predatah. I can't stand diddlas. But bein' loud don't make me a detective. Some things you gotta leave to people who know what they're doin'.
lines.direction: Loose conversational swagger, spontaneous rhyme and comic timing.

lines.text: Bro, you ever actually read that book? I was sittin' there one night, cryin' my eyes out. The Bible is beautiful, man. People think I'm all jokes. There's beautiful shit in this world. I'll show you my humanity.
lines.direction: Quiet, vulnerable and sincere; allow a beat of silence.

lines.text: Cokey Smokey, everybody knows me. Daddy Stanky, pockets lanky. I got a mixtape called Humanity and a whole city of people who think they're too good to listen. Their loss, bro.
lines.direction: Loose conversational swagger, spontaneous rhyme and comic timing.

lines.text: SHAWKTOOTH! Sorry. Daddy Stanky does that and everybody starts yelling. You won't hear him on a corporate playlist, but somebody always has his bootleg.
lines.direction: Underground music fan, animated and affectionate, natural conversational delivery.

lines.text: He rhymed through an entire livestream once. Even when he was arguing with his own chat. Ask him about the necklace, but don't expect the short version.
lines.direction: Underground music fan, animated and affectionate, natural conversational delivery.

lines.text: I used to think the guy was just a walking punchline. Then I heard Humanity. Dude can be surprisingly sincere. Keep a copy of that tape, the stream could disappear tomorrow.
lines.direction: Underground music fan, animated and affectionate, natural conversational delivery.

lines.text: Welcome to Sharktooth Sessions! No chat delay, no moderators, no subscription fee. You got a face, you got a voice. Make some noise!
lines.direction: Big live introduction; projected, comedic swagger.

lines.text: SHAWKTOOTH!
lines.direction: Excited crowd shout, brief and emphatic.

lines.text: No cashy, still flashy, suit man lookin' trashy. Three dead toes but I still got flows. They got a board of directors; I got a board with a busted speaker. I'll beat ya brain!
lines.direction: Rhythmic spoken freestyle, energetic, original bars.

lines.text: Yo, somebody asked me about the pendant again. Mother Mary, shit got scary. I got a whole book of bad decisions and somehow I'm still here. What a fuckin' story, bro.
lines.direction: Comic storytelling; allow room for a laugh.

lines.text: Tell 'em, Stanky!
lines.direction: Warm audience response.

lines.text: For everybody who ever got laughed at, written off, or left outside. This one's called Humanity. There's still beautiful shit in this world. I'll show you my humanity.
lines.direction: Slow down, sincere, no punchline.

lines.text: Humanity! We love you, man!
lines.direction: Warm closing crowd response.

lines.text: Fight night, baby. The champ's got a twelve-million-dollar sponsorship and the challenger got a coupon for a sandwich. Who you got?
lines.direction: Playful sports pundit energy.

lines.text: Stanky, you picked the loser three fights in a row!
lines.direction: Affectionate heckle, smiling.

lines.text: Wrongy the gongy. My predictions are an independent art form, bro. Ain't nobody payin' me for accuracy.
lines.direction: Fast absurd rhyme.

lines.text: Play that stupid frog beat again!
lines.direction: Audience teasing; original fictional novelty tune reference.

lines.text: You people got the worst taste in music. Except when you listen to me. Then you're fuckin' geniuses.
lines.direction: Mock outrage, amused.

lines.text: You good, man? You want some water?
lines.direction: Genuine concern, normal volume.

lines.text: Yeah, bro. Appreciate ya. That's my people right there. Roast me all night, still make sure I get home.
lines.direction: Warm, sincere.

lines.text: Patron saint of beating a diddla!
lines.direction: Exaggerated affectionate nickname, not a call to action.

lines.text: Calm down, little predatah! Tonight the only thing gettin' beat is your ego in a rap battle.
lines.direction: Comedic challenge.

lines.text: Three dead toes!
lines.direction: Playful familiar heckle.

lines.text: Nobody knows! You motherfuckers know my rhymes better than I do. Might as well put you on the payroll. There ain't a payroll, by the way.
lines.direction: Quick rhyming banter.

lines.text: You know we love you, Stanky.
lines.direction: Sincere, no sarcasm.

lines.text: I know. Sometimes I don't get it. But I know. No more jokes for a second. Thank you for showin' up.
lines.direction: Brief vulnerable pause.

lines.text: STANKY! STANKY!
lines.direction: Joyful crowd chant.

lines.text: I'll show you my humanity. Now quit lookin' at me like that. I'm not cryin', you're cryin'.
lines.direction: Tender, then playful.

lines.text: Stream's up. Local recording's running. If the megacorps take the feed down, I've got three copies.
lines.direction: Deadpan netrunner, casual and assured.

lines.text: Yo, five bucks and I'll do a backflip! No refunds if I eat pavement!
lines.direction: Very high energy, skinny adult male, rapid-fire delivery.

lines.text: Flippy the dippy! Boon, you motherfucker, you can't even stand still for the introduction!
lines.direction: Affectionate spontaneous rhyme.

lines.text: I'm not debugging your spine.
lines.direction: Dry delivery, slight smile.

lines.text: That's what you said last time! Stanky, tell 'em about the shark!
lines.direction: Infectious laughter, interrupts with enthusiasm.

lines.text: SHAWKTOOTH! My boy RC got servers in his closet. Boon got springs in his shoes. What the fuck do I got? Three dead toes!
lines.direction: Big comedic timing.

lines.text: A room full of people who showed up for you. That's not nothing.
lines.direction: Matter-of-fact warmth.

lines.text: Hell yeah, brother. We ain't goin' nowhere.
lines.direction: High energy softens to genuine loyalty.

lines.text: That's my crew, bro. No fancy label, no algorithm. Just my people. I'll show you my humanity.
lines.direction: Quiet heartfelt delivery.

lines.text: Synaxis badge? They let you go? Yeah. Seen that look before. Don't let a company convince you your entire life was a performance review.
lines.direction: Quiet recognition; no self-pity.

lines.text: Bro, you are OFF THE CLOCK. For the first time today nobody's measuring how fast you walk to the bathroom.
lines.direction: Exuberant but kind.

lines.text: They got a spreadsheet for your ass but not a chair for your soul. Sit with us a minute, bro.
lines.direction: Rhythmic, inviting.

lines.text: We run our own little stream here. No corporate account, no sponsors. If something breaks, I fix it. If Stanky breaks it, I fix it twice.
lines.direction: Understated humor.

lines.text: And I provide premium entertainment. Five bucks. Backflip. You know the deal.
lines.direction: Rapid playful pitch.

lines.text: Nah, leave the kid alone, Boon. Listen. You ain't your job. You got the whole fuckin' city out there. Find your people.
lines.direction: Warm, grounded emphasis.

lines.text: Come back when you feel like it. You don't owe us a delivery, a review, or a subscription.
lines.direction: Simple invitation.

lines.text: Welcome to the afterhours, baby.
lines.direction: Quiet smile.

lines.text: Good to see you again. Got the old recordings backed up. Turns out the internet's not forever if the people who own the servers decide otherwise.
lines.direction: Technical but personal.

lines.text: You saved the clip where I landed the flip, right? Not the one where I fell into the trash can?
lines.direction: Excited concern.

lines.text: Both. Archival integrity.
lines.direction: Perfectly dry.

lines.text: You motherfuckers make me laugh. I thought nobody would remember half this shit. Look at us now.
lines.direction: Laugh fades into sincerity.

lines.text: We remember, bro. All of it. Even the stuff you wish we'd forget.
lines.direction: Affectionate teasing.

lines.text: Keep the good with the bad. That's a whole human being, ain't it? Not just the highlights. That's Humanity.
lines.direction: Reflective.

lines.text: The archive stays with us. Nobody gets to erase it for a quarterly target.
lines.direction: Steady conviction.

lines.text: And you, new friend? Go make some memories of your own. We'll be here.
lines.direction: Warm farewell.
